title: Director, Strategic Sales
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

Zip is looking for a dynamic and driven Director of Strategic Enterprise Sales who excels in enterprise value-based selling motions and leadership. This role requires expertise in building and leading teams focused on delivering high-impact results through strategic, value-based cycles. 

We are seeking a candidate who has demonstrated success in past sales Enterprise leadership roles, consistently achieving quotas, hiring and developing sales talent, and possessing a strong background in complex sales motions with large F500 organizations. Emphasizing strong customer relationships within the sales process is critical for this role, as you will collaborate closely with C-level executives and your team on the front lines. Active participation in client meetings, crafting deal progression strategies, and providing proactive coaching are essential responsibilities.

To succeed in this role, you must possess a proactive customer-first mindset, demonstrate a strong commitment to Zip’s customer dedication and values, and aspire to lead and mentor high-performing sales teams while achieving outstanding outcomes. We are looking for someone to not only consistently exceed sales metrics but also build a strong culture and foundation in the EMEA market.

Please note this is a hybrid role out of our London office.

 

OPPORTUNITY FOR YOU TO

- Lead a team of direct Sales Executives to achieve aggressive new business and expansion sales targets in the region.

- Evolve and execute a comprehensive sales strategy in collaboration with cross-functional resources to effectively penetrate the market, analyze competition, and consistently overperform.

- Cultivate strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, our Partner network, and the Zip Executive team.

- Recruit, coach, and mentor team members to foster a culture of consistent performance and continuous improvement.

- Accurately report and forecast pipeline and performance to the business.

- Participate strategically in C-level meetings to gain insight into customer requirements and effectively map Zip’s solutions to high-impact business pain.

- Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets, contributing significantly to overall revenue goals.

- Deliver world-class client experiences to maintain and grow the client base through non-sales-related outreach. 

TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE

- Proven history of consistent overperformance.

- Demonstrated success in recruiting, coaching, and managing outstanding sales teams.

- Strong bias to action to implement strategies to continue Zip’s trajectory as a generational organization.

- Maintain a high standard for operational excellence across your team.

- Adept at building enduring relationships with Sr. Level Executives.

- Adaptable and effective in fast-paced and rapidly growing environments.

- Identifies, coaches, and promotes top performers and is relentless in development by providing actionable feedback.

title: Freelance Finance Content Writer
description:
Please note: We're currently at capacity and are not actively onboarding new writers right now. We continue to welcome applications, but it may some time before we are able to review and respond to your application.
Are you aching to write content that brings in real results and that people actually read rather than another generic piece of content?
Are you obsessed with understanding how a product works and how to make it appealing to a reader?
Do you continuously look for ways to improve your writing, and dream of becoming a writer who can confidently say their content brings in customers?
Then read on… this freelance position may be right for you!

*Please note: we aren't accepting candidates who are in full-time employment
About the position
Mint Studios is a content marketing agency that helps fintech companies like Modulr, Zai, Confused.com and Jeeves acquire customers with content. We use our four pillar framework to help fintech companies turn their blog into a customer acquisition channel:

• A content strategy based on customer research and focused on Bottom of the Funnel keywords

• Content written for the level of the reader and focused on the company's product

• Content based on interviews with subject matter experts

• Content results that can be tracked

We’re currently looking for writers to work with us. If you’re interested, here’s more information on what we’re looking for.
Responsibilities

• Write 3 - 4 articles per month for one client

• Each article is usually 2,000 - 3,000 words, and takes around 2 weeks to write in between rounds of edits

• 90% of articles are based on a recording of an interview with a subject matter expert combined with desk research

• The process includes one outline, then 2 rounds of edits

• Edit content based on feedback

• Complete a comprehensive questionnaire and outline (our version of the “brief”) before writing the first draft.

• Acquire knowledge about our clients, their products or services and the audience we’re targeting (you don’t need a background in fintech or financial services!)

What we're looking for
You don’t have to have a background in fintech - we can teach you that. What we really value is attitude and good writing.
These are the 7 characteristics of the best writers that we work with at Mint Studios :

•
You have clarity of thought. You can put together logical arguments in the written form and when you don’t understand something you’ll take the time to understand it.

•
You are inherently curious. You want to understand a topic inside out. You’ll do the right amount of research and ask the right questions till you feel confident writing and talking about the topic.

•
You are detail oriented. You care about delivering something great, even when no one is watching.

•
You’re constantly thinking of the bigger picture. You like to understand how the content in the interview fits into the product, the client, and the strategy.

•
You take responsibility for your skillset . You’re always trying to become a better writer and are open to new processes and ways of working.

•
You are empathetic. You can put yourself in the shoes of the reader and of the client. You try to understand their perspective and will ask questions if you don’t.

•
You like working with smart, fun and collaborative people where you are supported and your career is developed!

You might not be a good fit if...

• You don't enjoy explaining complex topics.

• You are a creature of habit and prefer to stick to your own writing processes or are not open to learning new processes.

• You don't enjoy the research process (understanding the topic, product and the content strategy in depth, listening to and analysing the interview for the main takeaways, etc).

• You don't like asking for advice, asking questions or you are not comfortable with feedback.

• You are not interested in improving your writing skills

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Agents & Automation
description:
Why you should join us:
Jerry .ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.
The opportunity is massive - car insurance alone is a $300B market in the U.S. We spent the last few years building our supply (we work with 100+ insurance carriers) and our technical infrastructure (60% of policies today are sold automatically without human intervention, 90% of inbound customer inquiries are resolved via AI and automation). The next chapter is about accelerating our growth - going from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.
The technical challenge:
Our insurance marketplace is our core product today, and our ability to automate the end-to-end shopping experience is our core differentiator. The AI & Automation team owns the most critical part of that - how we automate the entire insurance quoting experience for our customers and orchestrate complex, multi-step transactions with external insurance provider systems to finalize policy purchases.
Before off-the-shelf AI agents existed, we built our own proprietary infrastructure to scale automated insurance purchases and customer support. Today, 60% of insurance policies are sold automatically without human intervention, and 78% of inbound customer inquiries are resolved via AI and automation, with 83% reporting a positive experience.
Our current system is working but our use cases are rapidly growing as our business expands beyond car insurance and available AI models are also evolving. We need someone to lead the charge in building our “next generation” AI system, including building new automations for things like document validation (drivers’ licenses, proof of insurance, etc), voicebot expansion into stateful, phone-based interactions, and enable our bots to have direct external system navigation to resolve complex issues more quickly and accurately than human agents.
Note: You may see different job ads for this role at different job levels. We are only hiring one person. Our priority is finding the right person, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.
What you’ll own:

•
Our AI agents and automation system, which has two components:

• Agentic/conversational front end - chatbot, voicebot, computer-use agents; shape what the prompt engineering team builds next and keep the architecture sound as it scales.

• Backend workflow automation - build new automations for things like document validation (ex. licenses, proof of insurance), record disputes, transaction orchestration with external carrier systems.

• Evaluate emerging AI technology (voicebot, computer use agents, and beyond), make the call on what we invest in next, build and ship to production.

• Partner with OpenAI to evaluate and deploy next-generation voice models and workflow automation.

Who you are:

• 5+ years owning product strategy and execution for a technical product, ideally at an early-stage startup, where you worked hands-on enough with engineering to make technical tradeoff calls.

• You've made a call between two valid technical approaches based on business impact, not just technical elegance, and can reason through why.

• You've tinkered with a new model within days of its release, and you can explain why one architecture or approach is superior to another.

• Experience putting LLM-based systems into production, including the unglamorous parts: evals, regressions, latency, cost, and failure-handling.

Our tech stack: TypeScript (Nest.js, React), GraphQL, AWS (ECS/EKS, Lambda), LLM models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini)
While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

title: Product Manager/Product Owner
description:
Role Title: Product Manager / Product Owner
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Product Managers and Product Owners as expert contributors to an advanced customer project focused on AI system development. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
This is strictly an evaluation and analysis opportunity. It does not involve roadmap ownership, delivery management, sprint facilitation, stakeholder leadership, or programme governance. • Assess and compare AI-generated responses to a variety of writing prompts, including specifications, release notes, user-facing copy, and stakeholder updates.

• Score each response based on clarity, tone, adherence to instructions, and usefulness for the intended audience.

• Write detailed rationales explaining the reasoning behind each score, focusing on whether the content meets prompt requirements and audience needs.

• Spot factual inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and instances where content exceeds or misses prompt constraints.

• Collaborate virtually and asynchronously with project managers and reviewers to ensure consistency and quality in assessments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional experience as a Product Manager or certified Product Owner, with a strong record in cross-functional product development.

• Native-level English fluency and exceptional written communication skills.

• Extensive experience authoring and evaluating specifications, PRDs, acceptance criteria, release notes, or decision documents.

• Demonstrated ability to judge whether content is appropriately tailored for executives, technical stakeholders, or end users.

• Proven skill in providing actionable, written feedback on technical or user-facing documentation.

• Attention to detail, critical analysis skills, and the ability to work independently while meeting remote project deadlines.

• Familiarity with model evaluation, RLHF, or annotation is a plus, but not required.

title: Professional Services - Technical Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. • Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.

• 8+ years of experience in IT, Endpoint Engineering, or Cybersecurity

• Experience working under formal change control, audit, and security governance processes

• Experience validating image integrity and supporting image release, rollback, and testing

description:
Job Description: Fractional Marketing Leader (Demand Generation & Enterprise Pipeline)
Company : Flosum
Role Type : Fractional / Part-Time Contract (Short-Term Stint)
Location : Remote
Reports To : CEO
About Flosum
Flosum is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS organization. In a high-growth environment, our Go-To-Market (GTM) revenue engine is our most critical asset. We are building a tightly aligned, high-performance engine, and we need a tactical marketing leader to step in and own the growth framework.
Role Overview
We are not looking for a theoretical, high-level consultant who only delegates. We are looking for a Fractional Marketing Leader who is a true "Doer." Your primary mission is simple: You will completely own the enterprise pipeline. You will shield the CEO from daily marketing operational noise, step in to actively manage and lead our current marketing team, and build a predictable, scalable enterprise demand-generation engine.
Key Responsibilities

• Pipeline Ownership: Take full accountability for the creation, tracking, and velocity of the enterprise-grade sales pipeline (MQL to SQL to Pipeline Value).

• Team Management: Act as the direct leader for the internal marketing team, establishing KPIs, clearing roadblocks, and managing day-to-day execution.

• Enterprise Demand Gen Strategy: Design, execute, and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns tailored specifically for high-ACV (Annual Contract Value) enterprise accounts.

• Sales & Marketing Alignment: Partner closely with Sales and leadership to optimize the GTM engine, refine our Account-Based Marketing (ABM) playbooks, and support strategic selling initiatives.

• Reporting: Deliver clear, fluff-free metrics directly to executive leadership focusing heavily on pipeline ROI, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion rates.

Requirements

• Proven B2B SaaS Scaling Experience: You must have a track record of serving as an early marketing leader or key growth driver at a rapidly scaling B2B SaaS company, staying long enough to see the compounding impact of your strategies.

• Expertise in Enterprise Pipeline Generation: You must possess verifiable experience building pipeline for enterprise-level buyers ($100k+ ACV). You know how to penetrate deep into complex buying committees.

• The "Doer" DNA: You are highly tactical. While you understand the big picture, you are ready to roll up your sleeves, write copy, build campaigns, look at the data, and execute directly. Command of the Modern GTM Stack: Deep, hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM integration (Salesforce), ABM orchestration platforms, and intent data tools.

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

title: Winter 2027 Test Automation Engineer Co-op
locationText: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Manufacturing Test organization builds the software backbone that ensures every product we ship - on land, sea, and air - meets our quality bar before it goes out the door. As a Test Automation Engineer Co-op, you'll join a small, fast-moving software team building test executive tools, automation pipelines, and analytics that reduce operator time and improve our development cycle across multiple platforms.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

You will own one or more scoped projects end to end, with mentor support, over the engagement. Candidate projects include:

• Automated test sequence development - Build and validate a test executive script (Python) to automate a manual test procedure on an active manufacturing line. Deliverable: working automation script, documentation, and before/after cycle-time comparison.

• Cloud data integration - Connect a local test station's data output to our cloud data pipeline, including basic authentication handling. Deliverable: functioning data pipeline plus a short writeup of the integration approach and security considerations.

• Debug tooling / triage support - Investigate a recurring test failure mode, root-cause it, and build a lightweight tool or dashboard to help operators triage similar issues faster. Deliverable: root-cause writeup and a working triage aid.

• Desktop application feature - Design and implement a discrete feature (Windows or Linux) for an existing test executive application, in coordination with end users. Deliverable: shipped feature, basic test coverage, and user feedback summary.

• CI/CD pipeline improvement - Identify a manual step in our test software deployment process and automate it. Deliverable: working CI/CD improvement plus documentation for handoff.

• Device communication scripting - Write and validate a script to communicate with a test fixture or instrument over a standard protocol (USB, Serial, CAN, etc.). Deliverable: working script and a short technical note on protocol behavior/edge cases.

• These projects are program-focused examples, not a limit on scope.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Ability to complete an in-person 16-24 week internship in one of our offices in winter 2027.

 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

• Coursework or project experience with Python.

• Exposure to version control (git).

• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts or automated testing (unit, integration, or system-level).

• Coursework or project work involving multi-disciplinary collaboration (e.g., with EE/ME/Manufacturing teammates on a capstone or club project).

• Familiarity with device communication protocols (USB, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS232, RS485, Ethernet).

Task Authoring & Review: Author and review realistic evaluation tasks based on peer-reviewed journal manuscripts, scientific abstracts, conference posters, and presentation decks to inform AI tool development.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Credit
description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build and improve the machine learning models behind Mission Lane 's credit decisions.
The impact you'll make:
Behind every “yes” from Mission Lane is a model that had to see past a credit score to the story behind it, the kind of story that doesn't fit neatly into three digits. You'll build and sharpen the models that read that signal right: accurate enough to trust, fair enough to stand behind, and sound enough to move our customers forward.
A lot of our applicants don't have years of clean credit history to lean on, so the standard score alone doesn't get you very far. That means you'll get to dig into the interesting work of figuring out what else predicts repayment.
Mission Lane is still young, but we’ve landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation, and you'll learn and grow right along with us.
As Senior Data Scientist you will:

• Design, build, and deploy supervised learning models that power Mission Lane 's credit decisions, from first experiment through production

• Partner with credit risk and portfolio teams to translate open business questions into modeling problems, and communicate the trade-offs between them

• Monitor models already in production, catching drift and validating performance so they keep doing what they were built to do

• Apply strong software engineering practices to your modeling work, including test-driven development, code review, and refactoring

• Explore new data sources and modeling approaches using Mission Lane 's Python data stack.

Our core tech stack includes:
Python and the Python data stack (numpy, polars, scikit-learn), LightGBM, DVC, Kubernetes, Airflow, Google Cloud, and Chalk, our feature store.
You'll thrive in this role if:

• You're motivated by practical solutions, and curiosity is part of how you work every day.

• You haven't necessarily worked in credit or lending before, but you're excited to learn a domain where regulations and long-horizon predictions matter.

• You're comfortable with the full lifecycle of a model, including the less glamorous parts like data cleanup, monitoring, and validation.

• You work well with people outside data science and can explain a modeling decision in plain language.

Minimum qualifications:

• A degree in a quantitative field and 1+ years of work experience in a related role

• Experience creating, deploying, and managing supervised learning models in a production system

• Experience writing tested, reviewed, reproducible code, for data pipelines and model training alike, working fluently in the Python data stack.

• Familiarity with working at the command line, shell scripting, databases, and cloud computing services

• Ability to travel ~4+ times per year for high quality in-person collaboration

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience solving problems in consumer lending or fintech

• Experience with Airflow, Dagster, or other data pipeline platforms

Compensation: Annual full-time starting base salary range: $120,000 - $134,000
This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.
Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

title: Copy of Process Manager (Last Mile)
description:
At Rohlik, we own our end-to-end operations - from in-house technology and automated distribution centers to last-mile delivery. Delivering over 20,000 fresh and supermarket products same-day requires an operating model built on precision, cutting-edge automation, and data-driven decision-making.

As a Process Manager, Operations, you will be at the heart of optimizing and scaling this operational model across Central and Eastern Europe. You’ll sit right between business operations and product development, turning operational challenges into structured, high-performing processes and scalable technical solutions.

This is an analytical, highly hands-on role. You won’t just produce theoretical diagrams - you will spend time on the floor, analyze workflow data, design detailed process specifications for software developers, and ensure seamless rollouts across our multi-country fulfillment network.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- High-impact transformation: You will directly shape how our last-mile logistics operate as we scale across five European markets.

- Tech and automation focus: Work in an environment leveraging advanced warehouse automation, robotics, AI-driven decision systems, and autonomous last-mile delivery.

- Bridge operations and tech: Turn real-world fulfillment center friction into actionable engineering specifications and product roadmaps.

- Build for scale: Standardize methodologies across multiple sites while ensuring solutions are robust enough for rapid international expansion.

- Direct ownership: See the immediate operational impact of your work in metrics like cycle time, cost-per-order, and fulfillment accuracy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Process Analysis & Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes across fulfillment center and last-mile operations.

- Process Design & Specification: Develop and document detailed target process designs, translating business requirements into technical specs for Product Owners and developers.

- Methodological Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, VSM, and Ishikawa frameworks to streamline operational workflows.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product Owners, software developers, engineering, and local operational teams to validate, test, and implement solutions.

- Business Case & KPI Tracking: Define process KPIs, build business cases (ROI, budgets, timelines), and track the measurable impact of improvements post-rollout.

- Implementation & Readiness: Write SOPs, prepare change management documentation, and support site teams to ensure smooth process rollouts.

- Continuous Improvement: Feed field insights into continuous improvement roadmaps and strategic operational initiatives.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2-3 years of experience in operations, process engineering, or JIT logistics within fast-paced environments (e-commerce, retail, automotive, or 3PL).

- Strong process toolbox: Hands-on mastery of methodologies and tools like VSM, DMAIC, Ishikawa, and SIPOC.

- Data-driven mindset: Strong analytical skills paired with advanced Excel capabilities (pivot tables, complex formulas) to evaluate KPIs and drive decisions.

- Tech-translating ability: Proven experience translating operational business requirements into clear process documentation for software engineering teams.

- Solid documentation skills: Experience producing clear SOPs, training materials, and change management frameworks.

- Language skills: English proficiency at B2 level minimum (written and spoken).

- Flexibility to travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% across our operational sites in 5 countries (Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania).

Nice-to-haves:

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Apps & Experiences (AppEx) organization powers the unified web user experience (Snowsight) for Snowflake. Every major Snowflake customer interacts with our platform through these surfaces, making AppEx central to both customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

Within Appex, our team sits at the intersection of AI, platform, and user experience. We are on a mission to create an AI‑first, scalable, maintainable, and extensible UI platform from which all Snowflake user experiences can be built. The team owns:

- The serving layer that powers Snowsight, Snowflake CoWork, and UX features

- Developer tooling that enable our engineers to move fast and deliver

- Frontend infrastructure and shared services for product teams

- CI pipelines that ensure fast and reliable builds

- Testing and validation platform that maintains code and product quality

- The monitoring and logging stack that ensures observability and trust

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Snowsight is a large, complex single-page application serving interactive analytics, data engineering, and AI workloads. As our user base and feature surface grow, we must treat performance as a first-class citizen. description:
Overview
LMI is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to deploy, integrate, and extend SPECTR , our mission-focused asset visibility and sensor platform supporting Department of Defense customers. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can work directly with users, understand operational problems, and rapidly turn requirements into working technical solutions. You’ll operate at the intersection of software engineering, systems integration, and field delivery-configuring deployments, integrating customer systems and data, troubleshooting across the stack, and building new capabilities when configuration alone isn’t enough.
This position requires an active Secret clearance. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.
Remote (U.S.-Based) | 50-75% Travel Required
We’re looking for an engineer who likes building where the mission happens. You’ll work directly with DoD customers and alongside our Product, Mission Engineering, and core engineering teams to get SPECTR working in real-world environments. Some problems will require configuration. Others will require an API integration, script, deployment change, or new software capability. Your job is to figure out what’s needed, build it, validate it with users, and help turn field solutions into repeatable product capability.
Responsibilities

• Deploy, configure, integrate, and validate SPECTR in customer environments.

• Work directly with DoD users to understand mission workflows, technical constraints, and operational pain points.

• Integrate SPECTR with customer systems, APIs, databases, data sources, networks, and mission applications.

• Build production-quality integrations, APIs, scripts, automation, and software capabilities to solve field requirements.

• Troubleshoot issues across applications, databases, containers, cloud infrastructure, networking, and connected edge systems.

• Support technical demonstrations, pilots, field tests, and operational deployments.

• Partner with Field Product Leads to translate operational needs into technical solutions and Capability Requests.

• Work with core engineering teams to transition useful field-developed capabilities into the SPECTR product.

• Document configurations, technical solutions, and lessons learned to make future deployments faster and more repeatable.

• Travel approximately 50-75% to DoD installations and other customer locations.

Qualifications
What We’re Looking For

• Active DoD Secret clearance.

• 4+ years of software engineering, systems integration, solutions engineering, or similar technical experience.

• Strong development skills in C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages .

• Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and working with relational databases/SQL.

• Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting production software.

• Experience with Linux, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS/AWS GovCloud.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and distributed system troubleshooting.

• Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into working technical solutions.

• Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with technical and operational DoD stakeholders.

• Ability to operate independently, solve problems quickly, and work effectively in field environments.

• U.S. Citizenship required.

• Ability to travel 50-75%.

Bonus Points For

• Experience delivering software or integrated systems in DoD environments.

• Experience with RFID, IoT, sensor systems, edge computing, or asset tracking .

• Experience with .NET/C#, AWS GovCloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, or GitLab.

• Familiarity with RMF/ATO, IL5/IL6, or other DoD cybersecurity requirements.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Events Intern - Competitive Enterprise Institute
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Competitive Enterprise Institute:
 
The Competitive Enterprise Institute is a nonprofit think tank based in Washington which focuses on critical economic and regulatory policy issues.
 
CEI’s internship program provides interested students and recent graduates the opportunity to learn about and promote the principles of limited government, free enterprise, and individual liberty. A CEI internship gives applicants the opportunity to work alongside some of the most prominent regulatory affairs scholars and policy specialists.
 
CEI offers a number of internships across the various policy areas we work on, as well as internships in communications and marketing. Generally, CEI’s policy interns are assigned to work with a specific CEI expert for the duration of their internship; and our communications and marketing interns work with the CEI staff of each respective team.
 
CEI’s internship program is an invaluable educational experience. We work with interns to help them grow professionally, hone their skills, and cultivate lasting relationships. Ultimately, our goal is to give interns work that will help them further their careers. Interns are encouraged to be proactive, and exceptional interns are often given the freedom to shape their experience with us and the possibility to explore other opportunities at CEI.
 
Past CEI interns have gone on to work in the executive and legislative branches, federal regulatory agencies, academia, and at prominent research institutions and think tanks. A number of current CEI staff are former CEI interns.
 
You can find out more about CEI here and learn about our history here. You can see our team of experts here, and see some of our work here and here.
 
Events Intern:
Events interns assist with organizing policy-related events, including webinars, book forums, Capitol Hill briefings, and our celebrated Julian L. Simon Memorial Award Dinner. This hands-on role involves helping with event registration and logistics, designing promotional materials, and conducting topic, venue, and speaker research.
 
Qualifications:
Applicants must have a strong interest in policy and politics, capitalism and economics, and libertarian/conservative principles. Applicants must have strong research, writing, and organizational skills. Applicants must possess a professional demeanor and the ability to handle confidential and private information. Applicants should be able to work independently, effectively, and efficiently. A basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is a must.
 
CEI also seeks interns to work on policy/research, marketing - and from time to time, philanthropy/fundraising, government affairs, events, litigation, and IT. During the interview, we would be more than happy to discuss these other opportunities if they are available and of interest to you!
 
This role is in person, in Washington, D.C.

- Take part in the on-call rotation for customer-impacting incidents, owning the coordination of response and customer communication strategy while an incident is live.

- Drive adoption of the AI tools and systems we provide across triage, drafting, deflection, and QA, and pressure-test what CX Ops ships against real queue conditions.

- Track how your region performs against the other four, bring what's working to your peers, adopt what's working in theirs, and propose the practices you think should apply globally.

- Forecast coverage and staffing against volume, and flag gaps before they have impact.

- Hire, onboard, and develop team members to ensure readiness for future growth and evolving support needs

title: In-House Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
Paintgun is a dynamic creative agency on a mission to drive innovation by transforming growth plans into high-performing paid ads. Specializing in bold, visually captivating content, we partner with brands to deliver impactful campaigns that inspire, engage, and deliver results. At Paintgun, creativity meets strategy to redefine what’s possible in digital advertising.
We are looking for two talented and creative In-House Content Creators to join our team on a freelance basis. If you are passionate about creating engaging content, have a flair for storytelling, and enjoy working remotely, we want to hear from you!
Tasks

Develop high-quality content aligned with our brand's voice and objectives.
Collaborate with internal teams to brainstorm and execute creative ideas.
Create multimedia content, including text, images, and short-form videos, as needed.
Ensure content is optimized for digital platforms and meets project deadlines.
Adapt to feedback quickly and maintain a consistent quality of work.

Requirements

Proven experience in content creation or a similar role (include links to your social media channels like Tiktok and Instagram).
Strong creative and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote setting.
Proficiency with content creation tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
Familiarity with social media platforms and trends

Benefits

Flexibility to work from anywhere.
Competitive freelance rate.
Opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic and creative team.

title: Senior Application/System Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) develops and markets technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges in the areas of energy, safety, security, aviation, productivity, and global urbanization.
We are a leading industrial and software company committed to delivering cutting-edge technological solutions that enhance efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety for high-growth businesses operating across a wide range of strategic and attractive industrial markets.
Our products and solutions help make the world safer, more comfortable, and more productive, improving the quality of life for people around the globe.
THE BUSINESS UNIT
Compressor Controls Corp. (CCC) is a Honeywell business unit specializing in the provision of control hardware, software, and services for turbomachinery applications. Our solutions help optimize the performance, efficiency, and reliability of turbomachinery systems across a variety of industrial sectors.
We work closely with our customers to deliver customized solutions that meet their specific needs and requirements.
The Senior Application Engineer/System Sales Engineer will provide technical and commercial support during the sales process by understanding the customer process and needs, and identifying the rotating equipment control solutions offered by the Honeywell CCC group.
The main focus of the Senior Application Engineer/System Sales Engineer will be to assist the organization in winning orders by providing technical rotating equipment expertise and solutions to our customers by supporting CCC group customers within the assigned region in conjunction with the Account Managers.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/DUTIES:

• Provide technical and strategic support for Brownfield and Greenfield sales opportunities by reviewing, validating, and presenting CCC solutions to customers.

• Act as the regional Subject Matter Expert for TMC (Turbomachinery Controls optimization ), support Application Engineers and Dynamic Simulation sales activities, conduct site surveys, support startups and training, and assist with proposal, contract, and scope qualification reviews.

• Serve on Project Review Boards for regional projects.

• Act as the primary technical resource throughout the sales cycle, collaborating with customers, third-party stakeholders, Account Managers, and internal teams to develop and advocate optimal CCC solutions while building synergies across the Honeywell organization.

• Lead regional technology seminars, sales events, and customer workshops to promote CCC turbomachinery control solutions, strengthen customer relationships, gain market insight, and demonstrate the value of CCC technologies and applications.

• Develop regional technical and application expertise through customer engagement, mentoring project execution teams, and supporting account strategies to drive growth and successful solution adoption across the region.

• Follow all company safety policies and procedures

• Respond to change productively and handle other duties as required

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Master’s Degree in Automation and Control Engineering or Mechanical Engineering

•
Five years experience in rotating equipment control systems as SME (Subject Matter Expert) or related field or related experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Experience in Oil & Gas / Chemical Industry field is preferred

• Native proficiency in the local language (Italian or Dutch) and strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Must be eligible and able to obtain work visa or work permit in country/site of field assignment(s)

• Valid international driver’s license mandatory

title: Manager RevOps/Yield -100% Remote
description:
About Spine Media

Spine Media is an audience growth technology company leveraging its Machine Learning and AI technology to acquire the most valuable audiences. Spine Media produces original content across 5 unique sites with over 500 Million sessions and 8 Billion pageviews. Our proprietary ad technology can measure a user value by the content they consume and the ad revenue they generate in real time.
The Manager of Rev Ops/Yield will be a yield expert that analyzes patterns and makes data-driven decisions.
Job Responsibilities

• Serve as the escalation point for troubleshooting, testing, and implementation of ad operations

• Manage 3rd party vendor relationship including checking in on completed tasks and duties ensuring work has been completed within the timeline given

• Assist in development and maintenance of our publisher network and maintain the effectiveness of the revenue generation throughout the network.

• Help to oversee day-to-day optimizations of sites and demand stack around performance.

• Lead the team in finding all inaccuracies in revenue, impressions, clicks and other KPI metrics where possible and fix them in a timely manner

• Assist in the evaluation of new technologies, and testing those on the sites.

• Help to develop means to streamline process flow

• Stay current and aware of changes and updates in ad server and proprietary tracking software and help communicate to necessary teams

• Correctly traffic ad tags to vendors in a timely manner.

• Provide ongoing status of experiments and implementation to the appropriate teams

• Participate in and oversee in the QA process Interface regularly with partners; resolve issues that arise including reporting discrepancies, creative policing, trafficking requirements

• Manage Documentation of protocols associated with the team and proper workflows

• Manage staff productivity and allocation of resources in collaboration with the CRO/CMO, Digital Ad Operations, to ensure company goals are met.

• Liaises with finance where needed on invoicing and new business Manage staff performance to meet or exceed internal expectations.

• Develop, motivate and train Digital Ad Operations Associate and Specialist team members as appropriate

• Participate in Corporate projects as assigned

• Create and manage Private Marketplaces (PMPs) and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Digital Media/ ad tech space preferably with a major SSP / DSP or large-scale publisher/channel partner

• 2+ managing Customer Success and/ or Ad Operations teams

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• Highly proficient in Excel / Google sheets

• Expert in GAM (google ad manager), GTM, GA and other Google products

• Previous experience working with supply side platforms, ad servers, data management platforms and other tech partners. DSP / SSP/ EXCHANGES (AOL, Google, Index etc.)

• Deep understanding of ad monetization at scale, including both demand & supply side, programmatic (Header Bidding, PMP, SSP, DSP, RTB, Video, Native etc.)

• Excellent communication skills

• Ability to manage a small global remote team in different time zones

• Exceptional understanding of ad systems and technologies including Operative 1, Salesforce, Google Ad Manager, Ad-Juster, FreeWheel, DBM,, MOAT, IAS and all other

• Expertise in training various ad operations disciplines and concepts

• Understanding of Google data studio and Analytics in depth.

• Strong knowledge of campaign lifecycle management, ad sales process, trafficking, QA, performance analytics/reporting

Additional Skills and Characteristics

• Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

• Experience using Asana, Jira, and slack

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to quickly master new productivity software application tools

• Proven self-starter, with ability to drive initiatives and end goals

At Spine Media , we celebrate a diverse and inclusive workplace

title: Snowflake
description:
SnowFlake Developer

• Model of working : Remote

• Working Hrs - 2 pm to 11 pm IST hrs

• Exp - 8+ years

Skills needed:

• One key area: depth in knowledge of SAP Data and its acquisition for data platforms

•
Expertise in managing SAP data acquisition ( SAP data extraction > loading to Data platforms such as Snowflake etc.)

This involves expertise in handling different data scenarios ( delta loads, full loads and large volumes, CDC processing, error handling etc .)

• Knowledge of prominent data tables of key SAP process areas (such as data in procurement, sales etc. of SAP ECC )

• Experience of handing large data platform migrations for SAP sources (e.g. re-mappings, reconnections and reloads when ECC to S4 migrations happen etc.)

• Typically these will involve a data replication tool for mappings and data load jobs . Good if the person knows SNP Glue, but even other tools such as SLT / Replicate etc. used for data replication are ok)
